testPlan.title: Span picks round a loop: the start stays

test.title: The game loaded this test version
test.hint: Load Welker Farms, savegame 3. This ticks by itself.

test.title: Carry the end round the loop
test.hint: Smooth tool. On the spline loop, click a point, then click on point by point, all the way round and onto the road. The start never moves. PASS if so.

test.title: Click the start to move it
test.hint: Click the span's start, then the point next to it. Now the start moves and the far end stays. PASS if so.

test.title: Apply the rebuild
test.hint: Right-click to apply. This ticks by itself.

test.title: Only the picked span changed
test.hint: The new points lie where the preview was. The rest of the loop is as it was. PASS if so.
